<3401The Basics of Battle

By Tutorio Lerngood<1A<0C
<3000So, brave <07, you will presently set forth upon a grand adventure in the land of Alefgard.<1A<0C
Now, I do not mean to alarm you, but you should know that foul fiends wait to assail you every step of the way.<1A<0C
You will have no choice but to take up arms. Be it with weapons, spells or items, you must strive to survive at any cost!<1A<0C
Should your health reach zero, all is lost! So do not be afraid to flee, for discretion is often the better part of valour!<1A<0C
But should you emerge victorious, you will be showered with experience points, gold coins, and even items!<1A<0C
And when you have earned a sufficiency of experience points, your level shall increase, and your might along with it.<1A<0C
And there ends today's lesson.<0C

<3401Four Steps Toward Mastering Movement

By Tutorio Lerngood<1A<0C
<30001. Move the directional pad up, down, left or right to walk in the desired direction. Diagonal movement is sadly beyond you.<1A<0C
2. Whilst standing still, tap the screen in a place which looks promising to perform a variety of useful actions.<1A<0C
Such actions include talking, opening doors, and examining your surroundings.<1A<0C
3. Tap the Menu icon, and the main menu will miraculously appear.<1A<0C
Here, you can check your current state of health, arrange your equipment, and use all manner of items and spells.<1A<0C
To cancel any action within the menu, simply tap the Back button.<1A<0C
4. Should you ever become confused, open the menu and select ‘Misc.’<1A<0C
Doing so will grant you access to a range of invaluable resources, not least among them these humble tutorials.<1A<0C
Here, you may also adjust the speed of battle messages...<1A<0C
...create a quick save log, enabling instant suspension of your adventure...<1A<0C
...and adjust the volume of the game's sound to a level befitting the acuteness of your hearing.<1A<0C
And there ends today's lesson.<0C

<3401Taking a Break from Your Adventure

By Tutorio Lerngood<1A<0C
<3000There is one thing which an adventurer must never ever do upon any account...<1A<0C
And that is to force this noble application to close.<1A<0C
Doing so will mean abandoning your adventure without a record of your progress being made.<1A<0C
When you wish to call a halt to your quest, you must visit the King, and he will record your progress in an adventure log.<1A<0C
Simply select a slot in which to save, and your heroic deeds shall be added to the annals of history.<1A<0C
The next time you play, you will begin again from the throne room where you saved.<1A<0C
You may alternatively elect to record your deeds in a quick save log.<1A<0C
But should you create a quick save log from another adventure log, the previous log will be lost for all eternity.<1A<0C
It is therefore more prudent to record a full adventure log. That way, defeat need not spell disaster.<1A<0C
And there ends today's lesson.<0C

<3401Attributes Explained

By Tutorio Lerngood<1A<0C
A hero's ‘level’ serves as a measure of his experience, and denotes his overall ability.<1A<0C
<3000All heroes begin at Level 1, and raise themselves to higher levels by gaining experience through battling monsters.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Health points’, known commonly as ‘HP’, serve to indicate a hero's physical well-being.<1A<0C
<3000Should your health reach zero, either due to the wounds of battle, or the effects of poison, you will fall down, defeated.<1A<0C
All is not lost, however...<1A<0C
Soon after you have tasted defeat, you will awake before His Majesty the King, ready to rejoin your adventure.<1A<0C
This miraculous preservation we owe to the divine protection of Almighty Rubiss! Praise be unto Her!<1A<0C
<30FF‘Magic points’, known commonly as ‘MP’, confer the power to cast spells.<1A<0C
<3000It is through the use of these precious points that men may weave wondrous magics.<1A<0C
<30FF‘G’ stands for ‘gold coins’.<1A<0C
<3000Gold coins are the money that makes the world go around.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Strength’ is a measure of one's physical power.<1A<0C
<3000The greater your strength, the more potent your attacks will be.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Agility’ is a measure of one's swiftness.<1A<0C
<3000The more agile you are, the more likely you will be to strike an enemy before he can strike you.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Resilience’ indicates your body's ability to bear the blows of foes.<1A<0C
<3000The greater your resilience, the less damage you will suffer at the hands of your enemy.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Max. HP’ and ‘Max. MP’ indicate... Can you guess?<1A<0C
<3000Correct! ‘Max. HP’ and ‘Max. MP’ indicate your maximum health points and maximum magic points respectively!<1A<0C
Rest overnight at an inn, and both will be restored to their maximum values.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Attack’ measures how hard you hit.<1A<0C
<3000The higher your attack, the more damage you will inflict when you strike a foe.<1A<0C
And the better your weapon, the higher your attack will climb.<1A<0C
<30FF‘Defence’ dictates how much punishment you are able to endure.<1A<0C
<3000The better your defence, the less damage you will take from the blows of your foes.<1A<0C
And the better your armour, the higher your defence will climb.<1A<0C
<30FFFinally, ‘Exp.’ stands for, yes, ‘experience’.<1A<0C
As you gain experience, your level will increase, and your attributes will improve.<1A<0C
And there ends today's lesson.<0C
